diagnostic_identity: with same F and before log safety clipping, paired multiclass log-loss difference equals conditional difference on finish rows and zero on decision rows; verify and report any clipping exceptions. This identity does not imply multiclass Brier/calibration improvement.
primary_finish_node: authoritative frozen MOV0_MIN OOF predictions; join exact fight_id and outer_year; never refit MOV0
primary_metric: multiclass log loss mean(-log(probability of actual class)); clip selected class probability to [1e-15,1-1e-15] for logs only
scoring: same frozen4260 IDs; A original K and B/C outcome-blind scores
secondary: multiclass Brier = mean(sum over3 classes (pclass-onehot_yclass)^2), no division by3
classwise one-vs-rest calibration intercept/slope, 10-bin ECE/reliability/Wilson actual rate
3x3 mean assigned probability by actual outcome
secondary_MOV0_FULL: deferred from V1 primary run; separate authorization needed to replace primary MIN or add a sensitivity run
sum: identically1 in real arithmetic; float64 assert abs(sum-1)<=1e-12, rtol0; no renormalization
